Bug_Title: Members ignored during record serialization should not be used
Bug_Explanation: The bug is due to the presence of serialization-specific methods and fields in a record class that implements Serializable. Records automatically serialize their components, and these methods and fields are ignored.
Trigger_Explanation: The testShowBug method calls the showBug method on a RecordExample instance which, due to the presence of ignored serialization methods and fields in the RecordExample class, highlights the bug of having noncompliant serialization methods and fields that are ignored during serialization.
